checks.name: loop_runtime_budget_admission_and_settlement
checks.run:
import json, secrets, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.loop_passport import init_loop, build_loop_passport, start_budget_session, admit_budget_action, settle_budget_action, budget_session_status
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    manifest_path = Path(init_loop(root, 'smoke-runtime', 'smoke-owner')['path'])
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    manifest['budgets'].update({'max_iterations': 2, 'max_wall_seconds': 20, 'max_tokens': 200, 'max_cost_usd': 2})
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding='utf-8')
    passport = Path(build_loop_passport(root, manifest_path)['paths']['json'])
    run_id, action_id = (secrets.token_hex(16), secrets.token_hex(16))
    assert start_budget_session(root, passport, run_id)['status'] == 'ACTIVE'
    estimate = {'iterations': 1, 'wall_seconds': 5, 'tokens': 50, 'cost_usd': 0.5}
    assert admit_budget_action(root, passport, run_id, action_id, estimate)['status'] == 'ADMITTED'
    actual = {'iterations': 1, 'wall_seconds': 6, 'tokens': 55, 'cost_usd': 0.6}
    assert settle_budget_action(root, passport, run_id, action_id, actual)['status'] == 'SETTLED'
    status = budget_session_status(root, passport, run_id)
    assert status['usage']['iterations'] == actual['iterations'] and status['usage']['wall_seconds'] == actual['wall_seconds'] and (status['usage']['tokens'] == actual['tokens']) and (status['usage']['cost_usd'] == '0.6') and (status['pending_action'] is False)
print('LOOP_RUNTIME_ADMISSION_PASS')
